study: A03E6 prospective mathematical theory-to-conditional-eBOSS-RR operator bridge, registered after original E4 mock-only results and source-only E5 readiness; synthetic/code-only interface until independently calibrated physical wake model and final eBOSS observable exist
registration_boundary: Before new E6 synthetic maths tests and source-only operator-interface implementation; E4 results already inspected and are explicitly retrospective; not a preregistration of any numerical physical acceptance threshold

unchanged_original_empirical_operator.note: This E6 CI will NOT open the original NPZ, FITS or observed randoms. Matrix numerical application is demonstrated only on deterministic synthetic positive RR using unchanged canonical conditional_window_block; original SHA pins identify future already-cached operator input without authorizing a new download.

math_contract.estimated_quantity: Expected conditional finite-bin cross-Landy-Szalay xi(s,mu) projected to signed odd ell at coarse s and cap; it is not a fully validated continuous survey window.
math_contract.fine_s_edges_Mpc_over_h: integers 20 through 140 inclusive (120 fine one-Mpc/h cells, centers 20.5 through 139.5)
math_contract.pilot_vector_order: cap NGC then SGC, output ell 1 then 3 within each cap, s bins 20-40,...,120-140
math_contract.input_theory_units: Dimensionless physical prewindow xi_ell(z,s) coefficients of P_ell(signed_mu), no per-component maximum normalization or inherited DESI HOD calibration
math_contract.output_units: Dimensionless binned xi_1/xi_3 in same orientation as original eBOSS mock-only LS pilot
math_contract.equation: y_{cap,o,J} = sum_{ell=0}^4 sum_{i=0}^{119} M_{cap,o,ell}[J,i] xi_{cap,ell}(s_i) under the original finite-bin piecewise-constant fine-s approximation
math_contract.window_kernel: M_{cap,o,ell}[J,i] = (2o+1)/(mu_max-mu_min) * sum_{j=0}^{239} RR_{cap,i,j}/sum_{i in J}RR_{cap,i,j} * integral_{mu_j}^{mu_(j+1)} P_o(mu)P_ell(mu)dmu for i within J
math_contract.decomposition: intrinsic odd input ell=1,3 + induced even-to-odd contributions from ell=0,2,4. The latter can be nonzero when physically even amplitudes vary across fine s and finite-bin RR(s,mu) is nonseparable.
math_contract.zero_and_constant_closure: Exact linearity and zero field; constant-in-s pure ell0/ell2/ell4 cannot produce odd except documented edge numerical quadrature tolerances. Do not equate this synthetic closure with zero physical leakage.
math_contract.signed_tracer_reversal: If tracer order is reversed, flip signed mu and all odd output coefficients; do not reuse original LRG_to_ELG matrices as if they had reversed orientation.
math_contract.relevant_redshift_caveat: Existing [0.9,1.0) operator marginalizes over pair redshift; z-dependent physical xi_ell(s,z) requires a separately validated effective-z or redshift-conditioned operator and corresponding selection weights. Never silently set z_eff=0.95 or import DESI effective redshift.
math_contract.physical_model_normalization_caveat: Existing DESI build_lrg_elg_wake_template.py explicitly max-normalizes wake and doppler shapes and fits free amplitude. Existing DESI build_lrg_elg_physical_odd_basis.py uses ideal-shell s^2 bin average before RR and omits needed released-eBOSS tracer calibration. They are direction-level research inputs, NOT an absolute physical prediction in eBOSS xi units.

systematics_budget_symbolic.only_if_physical_model_and_EBOSS_C_exist: A future independently calibrated prewindow physical wake/null model must be propagated to the same 24D (or newly predeclared final pD) observable using the same validated operator, with an independently calibrated eBOSS statistical covariance C and nuisance matrix B.
systematics_budget_symbolic.metric: Use W=C^{-1}, t_perp=t-B(B^T W B)^{-1}B^T Wt, physical amplitude bias delta_A=(t_perp^T W delta_y)/(t_perp^T W t_perp) and sigma_A=(t_perp^T W t_perp)^{-1/2}. Here delta_y is a calibrated systematic-response difference in the same observable units. Do not evaluate with DESI C or a shape-only physical amplitude.
systematics_budget_symbolic.threshold: UNDEFINED until physical model, selection systematic class, covariance, target coverage and predeclared independent held-out calibration are specified. If t_perp is degenerate, STOP.

synthetic_ci_contract: Verify all pinned parent Git blobs, original math geometry and enforced post-E4 STOP before testing
Use only synthetic strictly positive 120x240 RR; check 10 original conditional 6x120 window blocks and 24-element output layout, odd/even split, linearity and zero control
Pure constant even input must not create odd above original numerical integration tolerance; positive odd input must recover normalized synthetic response within numerical integration tolerance
A nonseparable signed-mu RR with fine-s-varying even field must produce nonzero odd finite-bin projection; mirror RR parity must follow (-1)^(out+in)
A nuisance-projected covariance matched-filter amplitude bias formula must pass synthetic SPD and singular/null negative controls without importing any DESI/eBOSS empirical C

Reject improperly max-normalized shape-only DESI basis as an absolutely calibrated eBOSS physical wake template, reject hard-coded z_eff, incorrect 18D pilot truncation, wrong cap/orientation and any observed access
